label: Counting occurrences
subgoals: Test whether every literal of the cube appears in each product term
Count the product terms the cube divides across all functions
Discard candidates that divide only one product term

label: Literals after extracting a cube
subgoals: Remove k literals from each of the m divided cubes
Add one literal X to each of those cubes
Add the k literals of the new node X

label: The value formula
subgoals: Compute the saving as m times k minus m minus k
Compare the savings of all candidate cubes
Extract the best candidate and recompute the occurrence counts
